name: shinchantw_cbt_tc_102901_timeline_20260729_185830_689336
sql:
SELECT "#account_id" AS account_id,
       "#event_time" AS event_time_utc,
       CAST(TRY_CAST(product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS product_id,
       pay_currency, pay_amount
FROM ta.v_event_18
WHERE "$part_event"='charge' AND "$part_date"='2026-07-29'
  AND (sandbox IS NULL OR sandbox=FALSE) AND (is_freebuy IS NULL OR is_freebuy=FALSE)
  AND CAST(TRY_CAST(product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT)=102901
ORDER BY "#event_time";
